title: B2B Website Email, Phone & Agency Contact Enricher

websites.title: Bulk Websites / Domains to Enrich (Optional — Paste Any List of URLs or Domains)
websites.description: Pass any list of company domains or URLs (from Google Maps, Clay, Apollo, n8n, or CSVs) to extract verified business emails, phone numbers, LinkedIn, X/Twitter, GitHub, and contact pages. Leave empty to auto-pull verified B2B agencies from the built-in partner directories below.

directorySource.title: Built-In B2B Partner Directory Source
directorySource.description: Select which B2B Partner Ecosystem to pull and enrich leads from (or choose 'custom_urls_only' if you only want to enrich your own 'websites' list above).

searchQuery.title: Keyword / Tech Stack / Location Filter
searchQuery.description: Optional keyword to filter leads by company name, tech stack (e.g., OpenAI, HubSpot, Airtable, Stripe, Kubernetes), service, or country.

maxItems.title: Max B2B Leads to Enrich
maxItems.description: Maximum number of enriched B2B company records to output.

crawlContactPages.title: Deep Crawl Internal /contact, /about & /impressum Pages
crawlContactPages.description: Automatically discovers and crawls internal contact, about, and legal pages plus JSON-LD schemas to maximize verified email and phone hit rates.

onlyWithEmails.title: Only Output Leads with Verified Emails
onlyWithEmails.description: If enabled, skips any domain where no verified business email address was found.
